title: Torsion-Born Early Dark Energy
author: Danny Lee Eldridge
summary: In Einstein–Cartan gravity, spacetime can twist (torsion) as well as curve. The Barbero–Immirzi field that comes with torsion behaves like a new scalar field. Danny's theory gives it the potential V = Λ⁴[1 − cos(φ/F)]³: it stays frozen early on, briefly adds about 5?6% to the universe's energy around redshift 3,500 (just before the CMB formed), then fades away. That shrinks the sound horizon and pushes the inferred Hubble constant up.
data: Planck 2018 CMB (temperature, polarisation, lensing) + DESI DR2 BAO + Pantheon+ supernovae

Best fit: f_EDE ? 0.054 at z_c ? 3,790 (free) and 0.057 at 3,495 (locked); S? ? 0.82, slightly higher than the standard model's 0.81

Locked Twist (switch-on tied to matter?radiation equality): ??? ?3.96 (??_eff ?4.15) with 2 settings, ?AIC ? 0.0: exactly on our pre-registered line (?4), so a split verdict. It beats free EDE on AIC by 2. Not blind.

fingerprint.title: A fingerprint only torsion has
fingerprint.equation: V(φ) = Λ⁴ [1 − cos(g(φ)/F)]³ ,  g(φ) ∝ sinh(φ/√(3/2) M_Pl + x₀)
fingerprint.text: In the torsion picture the natural dial is the Immirzi parameter γ itself. If the potential repeats in γ rather than in the field, it is lopsided in a way generic early dark energy is not. With the field's resting point fixed at loop quantum gravity's γ₀ ≈ 0.2375, it shifts the CMB acoustic angle by about 0.025% and the temperature spectrum by about 0.1%, right at Planck's precision. The fit's decision rule was written down before running.

threads.name: Whole-number width: result
threads.q: Can the data tell whether the width is 1.2247 ÷ a whole number?
threads.status: Untestable with these data: best N ≈ 8.9, anything from 7.7 to 10.1 fits within Δχ² = 1; the half-number controls (8.5, 9.5) fit only 0.15 and 0.5 worse than N = 9 (the rule needed 1). Pure-torsion width (N = 1) fails: Δχ² = +13.8.

threads.name: The shape of space
threads.q: Is space curved, or wrapped like Metatron-style solids (the dodecahedral universe)?
threads.status: Done: the dodecahedral curvature fits 163 points worse than flat (excluded). Curvature free gives Ω_k = 0.0002 for both the standard model and the Locked Twist: flat.

threads.name: The Cosmic Bell
threads.q: How does the Twist change the oldest light's sound waves?
threads.status: Computed from the AxiCLASS fits: the acoustic peaks don't move; the sound ruler shrinks 2.9% (144.9 ? 140.7 Mpc) so H? rises to 70.6. In CAMB the drag-epoch ruler shrinks 2.1% (147.5 ? 144.4 Mpc), H? 69.9.
